Compost bays

There are four shared compost bays by the north gate, and they are for green waste from the plots only. Put new waste in the bay with the open front, and take finished compost from the one that is marked as ready. Do not put roots of bindweed, cooked food or anything that is not from a plant into the bays.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
